info.name: Finalysis API
info.description:
Requests for the Finalysis backend, with tests. Run top to bottom against the local dev app (`./mvnw spring-boot:run`, **without** the `aws` profile) on a **freshly reset** dev database (`scripts/reset-dev-db.sh`): setup creates the accounts, so a second run fails. File uploads use paths relative to the repo root: run newman from there, or set Postman's working directory (Settings → General) to the repo root.

**The newman run** is folders 1–6 and **8. Categorization**, selected with `--folder` (the README gives the command). They use only fictional sample data and expect AI to be off: every AI request asserts `status: OFF` and 0 calls, so none can reach Bedrock.

**Left out of the newman run** (leave out their `--folder`, or untick them in the Collection Runner):
- **7. Real-file test**: manual runs with your own file, selected in Postman.
- **9. Lookups**: manual lookups by id.
- **10. Live AI (aws profile)**: needs the backend started with `SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=aws` and makes live Bedrock calls. Any request that needs the `aws` profile goes in this folder, never in the newman folders.

item.name: 8. Categorization
item.description: Phase 4 over the API, with AI **off** (no `aws` profile): runs, a correction and its full undo, "not a transfer" and its undo, the review-queue kinds `SUGGESTED_ONE_SIDED_TRANSFER`, `NOT_TRANSFER_UNCATEGORIZED` and `AI_CATEGORY_REVIEW`, and rules CRUD. Every AI request expects `status: OFF` and 0 calls; none can reach Bedrock. Runs after folders 1–6 on a freshly reset database; ids and expected counts are read from the API, not hard-coded.

request.description: Newman runs without the `aws` profile, so every AI request in this folder expects AI to be off.
